Legal

Terms of use

Terms governing use of the Occuo Health website and the status of the information published on it.

Template document. This notice is a starting point drafted for a general occupational health provider. Have it reviewed against your actual data practices and Egyptian law before publication.

Website content

The information on this website describes the services we offer. It is general information about occupational health practice and is not medical advice for any individual, nor a legal opinion on your obligations as an employer.

No clinician–patient relationship

Reading this website does not create a clinician–patient relationship. Individual health concerns should be raised with a qualified clinician. Fitness-to-work determinations are made only after an examination.

Regulatory references

References to Egyptian Labour Law No. 12 of 2003, ISO 45001 and resuscitation guidelines are provided for orientation. The obligations that apply to your organisation depend on your sector, headcount and hazard profile, and should be confirmed for your specific circumstances.

Service scope

Nothing on this website constitutes an offer. Services, deliverables and timescales are defined in a written proposal and contract.

Intellectual property

The content, design and code of this website are the property of Occuo Health Egypt unless otherwise stated.

Third-party links

We are not responsible for the content of external websites we link to.

Last updated: 2026. Questions about this notice can be sent to info@occuohealtheg.com.
